description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source test management tool. It generates charts and graphical summaries related to test plans and projects, including pie and bar charts for overall metrics, platform-specific metrics, keywords, and top-level suites. The script initializes parameters, loads configuration, checks user rights, and renders a Smarty template with chart URLs and data.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes user input parameters, manages access rights, and retrieves test project and plan information from the database.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Creates and returns a GUI object with properties for rendering, including whether charts can be used based on GD library support.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has the rights to view test plan metrics within a specific project or test plan.
